verdict: Casey's revenue jumped 24% to $5.7B as fuel sales surged, and wider fuel and in-store margins turned that into a 28% jump in earnings per share.

kpis.label: Fuel margin
kpis.note: per gallon, vs 41.0¢ a year ago

segments.name: Fuel
segments.note: Gasoline and diesel sold at 2,959 stores. Gallons sold rose only 2.5%, so most of the jump is fuel prices — but the profit per gallon also rose, to 47.8 cents, lifting fuel gross profit 20% to $447M. (Shown $1M lower than the reported $3,725M so the rounded lines add exactly to total revenue.)

segments.name: Grocery & general merchandise
segments.note: Packaged food, drinks and everyday goods sold inside the store — same-store sales up 2.7%, led by non-alcoholic beverages, at a 35.6% gross margin.

segments.name: Prepared food & dispensed beverage
segments.note: Pizza, sandwiches and drinks made in store — Casey's is one of America's largest pizza sellers. Same-store sales rose 4.8%, led by whole pizzas, at a rich 59.3% gross margin.

segments.name: Other
segments.note: Wholesale fuel, fuel terminals and other smaller activities outside the stores.

opex.name: Operating expenses
opex.note: Running the stores — staff, insurance and credit-card fees among the drivers; up 8% YoY with 64 more stores than a year ago.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Wear and tear on stores, kitchens and equipment, spread over their useful lives.

otherDetail: Interest expense, net of interest income, was $22M — the cost of Casey's borrowings.

takeaways.title: Fuel drove the top line
takeaways.text: Total revenue rose 24% to $5,678M, but gallons sold rose just 2.5% — this was mostly higher fuel prices flowing through the pump price, plus 64 more stores than a year ago.

takeaways.title: Margins did the real work
takeaways.text: Fuel margin widened to 47.8 cents a gallon from 41.0 cents, and the inside margin ticked up to 42.2%. Together they lifted gross profit to $1,239M and net income 27% to $274M.

takeaways.title: Pizza is still the inside engine
takeaways.text: Prepared food same-store sales rose 4.8%, led by whole pizzas, at a 59.3% gross margin — the highest-margin food Casey's sells. Inside sales overall grew 5.6% to $1,778M.

footerNote: Casey's reports in thousands; lines here are rounded to whole $M and tie exactly. Fuel segment revenue is shown as $3,724M (reported $3,725M) so the rounded segments sum to total revenue.
